style: Low-resolution pixel art sprite as in an old 16-bit game: the whole figure is built from clearly visible large square pixels (about 192 pixels tall), flat color blocks with simple hard-edged pixel shading, no smooth gradients, no anti-aliasing, no soft glow, no vector or anime-illustration look. Limited cool purple-violet palette (about 16 colors), dark gothic cozy mood, same pixel density and shading style as the reference.
core: The same original character as in the reference image: a young adult demoness with violet-grey skin, long dark purple-brown hair with side-swept bangs, TWO CLEARLY VISIBLE small curved dark horns sticking out of the top of her hair, long pointed ears, large calm half-lidded violet eyes, a slim pointed devil tail ending in an arrowhead tip. Keep her face, hair, horns, ears and tail tip identical in every image and every form.
rules: Single character only. Transparent background. Not sexualised for the casual form: relaxed, everyday, cozy poses only. No weapons, no text, no watermark, no extra limbs unless the form says so. Bat-like wings appear ONLY in the winged form. Always tasteful and non-explicit.

casual.outfit: wearing the same outfit as in the reference: a dark violet bikini-style top and dark violet shorts with a thigh strap, barefoot. Relaxed, playful, calm mood.
casual.use: чат, повторение карточек, загрузочный экран, пустые состояния

mecha.outfit: wearing the same outfit as in the reference: a dark hooded cloak with a round clasp and chains, belted dark tunic, wide sleeves, and mechanical robotic metal forearms and hands. Serious, focused, calm mood.
